summary: A one-time transfer of an app's on-device data to or from a device on another platform, through a migration extension. BifrOSt has archive and credential exchange models, but no migration extension, no export or import protocol and no migration status. iPadOS 26.1 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: No extension point for a one-time transfer.
The archive model is not an export protocol for migration.
Credential exchange moves passwords between managers; it is not a migration import.
No status type for a completed import.
No entitlement model for this transfer.
No test type for migration code.

gaps: No migration extension, export or import protocol, or migration status type.
